items.title: Meta launches Muse personal AI agent in Australia
items.summary_en: Meta says its Muse personal agent app is available in Australia, with local connector experiences (creativity, shopping, property, fitness, entertainment) rolling out progressively. Users can link services such as Gmail, Google Calendar, Instagram and OpenTable. Spaces are also available there, and a Mac app and AI-glasses support are mentioned.
items.notes: Direct fetch blocked (about.fb.com not in session allowed domains). Content and date taken from search snippets of the official page; not read in full.

items.title: Meta introduces 'spaces' to customize the Muse app
items.summary_en: Meta describes spaces as custom experiences users build inside Muse by describing an idea. They can be placed in the sidebar or main tabs, hidden, or scheduled (e.g., a weekly planner on workdays). Each space becomes part of Muse.
items.notes: Exact day unconfirmed (URL shows November 2026 only); may fall outside the 11-11 to 11-21 window. Snippet-based, page not fetched.

items.title: Meta welcomes Loblaw as first Canadian retail partner to Muse
items.summary_en: Meta newsroom post title indicates Loblaw joins as the first Canadian retail partner for Muse. No further detail was retrieved.
items.notes: Only title/URL seen in search results; exact date and content unverified; may be outside window.

items.title: Meta rolls out Muse Wonder-trained specialized models to Muse
items.summary_en: A Meta newsroom snippet says specialized versions of its models, trained with learnings from Muse Wonder, are rolling out to Muse. A secondary report dates the announcement to Nov 6, 2026 and says subscribers still get the full Wonder model for harder tasks.
items.notes: Outside the 10-day window and secondary; the primary Meta post was not located or dated. Included as context only; verify against Meta's own post.

coverage_note: ai.meta.com and about.fb.com could not be fetched (hosts need to be allowed in the session's network settings), so findings rely on search snippets. Meta's official newsroom shows at least one in-window post (Muse Australia launch, 2026-11-17); the spaces and Loblaw posts are dated only to November 2026. No new Meta AI research blog post or model release was found in the window. Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full were introduced on 2026-10-12 (https://about.fb.com/news/2026/10/introducing-muse-wonder-models/), which is out of window and not itemized.
